ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized scarring and edge markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark field with distinct high-contrast white clusters at the left and right distal tips. Symmetrical distribution of small circular white motifs on both lobes and a high density of multi-directional white linear tracks across the lateral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence point; approximate interior angle of 45 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire margin, featuring high-frequency peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes reaching 10-15 pixels at the mid-lobe sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve originating from the median notch, terminating in upward-hooked lateral tips on both the left and right extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters detected; notably a large focal rosette on the upper-right lobe and several smaller, discrete circular scars scattered across the central-left region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated heavily on the left distal tip and right-mid lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white scarring and probable barnacle colonization at the far-left tip; extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) indicative of inter-species interaction on both lateral margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Co-occurrence of pinniped figures (seals or sea lions) visible in the immediate foreground water pixels near the ventral surface of the fluke.
